name: KPI Card
description: A row of KPI cards from a plain date and your measures: MTD, last month or last day as the big number, worked out in the extension. Calculated KPIs (e.g. Average Loan Size = Loan Amount / Loans) are rolled up correctly for each period. Comparison, sparkline, secondary values and target progress.

encodings.name: Date
encodings.tooltip: A plain date at DAY level, e.g. DAY(Disbursement Date) or an exact date. MTD, last month and last day are calculated from it.

encodings.name: Measures
encodings.tooltip: Your basic measures, e.g. SUM(Loan Amount), COUNT(Loans), SUM(Balance). One card each; build ratios like Average Loan Size in Format Extension → Calculated KPI.
